+def _get_endpoint_context(dependant: Dependant) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Inspect endpoint metadata once, when building its request handler."""
+    context: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if dependant.path is not None:
+        context["path"] = dependant.path
+    call = dependant.call
+    try:
+        while isinstance(call, functools.partial):
+            call = call.func
+        call = inspect.unwrap(call)
+        if not inspect.isroutine(call) and not inspect.isclass(call):
+            call = call.__call__
+        context["function"] = getattr(call, "__name__", type(call).__name__)
+        filename = inspect.getsourcefile(call)
+        if filename:
+            _, line = inspect.getsourcelines(call)
+            context.update(file=filename, line=line)

+        # Builtins and dynamically generated callables may have no source available.
+        pass
